pcaf_methodology.listed_equity: market_value_meur / issuer_evic_meur * issuer_revenue_meur (PCAF Standard §B61 proxy — revenue substituted for direct issuer emissions due to absence of counterparty-level emission data in investment records)
pcaf_methodology.sovereign_bonds_note: issuer_evic_meur and issuer_revenue_meur are null for sovereign bonds by design. EVIC and revenue are corporate concepts not applicable to sovereigns.
pcaf_methodology.investments_counterparty_note: counterparty_id is null across all 50 investment rows. Investment attribution is maintained at bank level.

metadata.scope2_rec_reconciliation: scope2_market_tco2e is sourced directly from utility_invoices.scope2_market_tco2e, which already reflects market-based accounting with grid emission factors adjusted for renewable energy certificates and PPAs. The rec_registry.csv data is not subtracted again during preparation — it is used for disclosure narrative only (certificate type, volume, registry). There is no double-counting.
metadata.risk_rating_methodology: climate_risk_register.risk_rating is derived from a 5x5 risk matrix: scores 1-2 = low, 3-6 = medium, 8-12 = high, 15-25 = critical. Specifically: likelihood_score * severity_score; critical >= 15, high >= 8, medium >= 3, low < 3. This formula must be used verbatim if the rating methodology is described in the report.

vehicles_correction.method: Scope 1 fleet recalculated from annual_fuel_consumption_l * 2.67 kg_CO2/litre / 1000
vehicles_correction.reason: Pre-computed scope1_tco2e_2024 had errors including non-zero values for electric vehicles.
vehicles_correction.emission_factor_source: Empirically derived — consistent 2.67 kg CO2/litre across all fuel types
